resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Shard rebalance and flaky retry; same owner

title: Split gate shards by measured duration, retry a failed file once as flaky evidence, print failures first
body:
Outcome: the gate splits test files by measured duration (not file count), retries a failed file once with both results recorded as evidence (a pass-after-fail is reported as flaky, never silently green), and prints a failure-first summary line before any TAP.
Source: .krn/runs/lead/ci-research/report.md (rank 1). After t-q8j6r5c slice A (PR #234, K=min(4,cores), compact output): gate build 13 min -> ~6-7 min; shard groups were 46/46/46/46 files + 7 serial with uneven duration.
Proof: a shard-plan test with fixture durations and a retry test where the first run fails and the second passes (flaky reported); gate duration before/after on the same PR shape.

Hosted-runner fixture (2026-11-06): GitHub Actions run 42239340289 (PR #247 head a3dae2b), Test (5/6): test/hosts/codex-registration.test.ts 'child exit during blocked onStarted remains cancellable and hands back the lease' failed with 'Codex systemd-scope cancellation could not be verified' (src/hosts/codex.ts:867); same file passed on runs 42230744714 and 42232493802. Timing flake in systemd-scope cancel verification, not a hosted-runner setup issue.
